A [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mistress''' of a [[Unidentified senator (mistress)|senator]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and she began to write a tell-all book about the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] secrets; however, she was convinced to change to a romance novel instead.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Scorned}}</ref>
